# @rnw-community/nestjs-rxjs-logger

> NestJS default logger wrapper for RxJS streams: pipeable per-level logging operators, logged stream creation, and
> catch-and-rethrow logging. Peers: `@nestjs/common`, `rxjs`.

## Guides

- [Basic operators example](readme.md#basic-operators-example): Logging inside a pipe with a per-level operator.
- [Create stream example](readme.md#create-stream-example): Starting a logged stream with `create$`.
- [Catch and rethrow example](readme.md#catch-and-rethrow-example): Logging stream errors with `catch` and rethrowing them.
- [Set logger context](readme.md#set-logger-context): Setting a default context with `setContext`.

## API reference

- [`AppLogLevelEnum`](readme.md#apploglevelenum): `debug` / `error` / `info` / `verbose` / `warn` level accepted by `print` and `create$`.
- [`NestJSRxJSLoggerModule`](readme.md#nestjsrxjsloggermodule): Module providing `NestJSRxJSLoggerService` bound to the NestJS `Logger` under the `'LOGGER'` token.
- [`NestJSRxJSLoggerService`](readme.md#nestjsrxjsloggerservice): Transient-scoped service with per-level pipeable operators plus `create$`, `catch`, `setContext`, and `print`.

## Architecture & conventions

- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/rnw-community/rnw-community/blob/master/packages/nestjs-rxjs-logger/AGENTS.md): Source layout, implementation patterns, dependencies, and coverage.
